listing.name: Heretic II / Heretic2R (m-x-d)
listing.summary: Play Heretic II with Heretic2R’s widescreen display, smoother effects and OGG music support.

steps.title: Prepare a separate Heretic2R copy
steps.instruction: Use the Windows runtime ZIP in a separate folder. Copy your Heretic II version 1.06 base folder into it, excluding the original DLL files; keep the original installation untouched. Finish setup with Heretic2R.exe.

steps.title: Keep saves and settings
steps.instruction: Heretic2R stores saves, settings, screenshots and logs in your Windows Saved Games/Heretic2R folder. Keep that folder when updating the upstream runtime.

steps.title: Optional CD music
steps.instruction: For OGG music, place your own CD tracks named track02.ogg through track14.ogg in base/music inside the separate runtime folder.

warnings: Heretic2R saves and runtime modules are incompatible with the original Heretic II versions. Use Heretic2R’s supplied modules and retain the original copy separately.
